name: agent-verification-kit
description: Evidence-required completion for agentic coding, enforced by hooks rather than by instructions. Blocks a commit unless a fresh verification stamp exists; the stamp is earned only by a passing test or build command, scoped to the repository being committed to, expiring after 30 minutes, and cleared by any file edit. Also refuses a commit whose agent definitions name a model that does not resolve. Governs this harness only — see README for what that does and does not cover.
